reference_resolution.rule: decision_id must resolve to an actual ADR file under docs/decisions/; considered_options must each resolve to a real alternative discussed in that ADR — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: outcome is recomputed from the referenced ADR's own status field, never asserted independently of the ADR text.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a cross-module design choice is proposed on the branch AND no architecture record exists yet for that decision
